<?php
// Read input
$input = trim(fgets(STDIN));
list($n, $m, $a, $b) = array_map('intval', explode(' ', $input));

// Option 1: all single tickets
$cost_single = $n * $a;

// Option 2: as many m-ride tickets as possible, remaining with singles
$full_m_tickets = intdiv($n, $m);
$remaining_rides = $n % $m;
$cost_mixed = $full_m_tickets * $b + $remaining_rides * $a;

// Option 3: cover all rides with m-ride tickets only
$cost_all_m = (int)ceil($n / $m) * $b;

// Minimum of all options
$min_cost = min($cost_single, $cost_mixed, $cost_all_m);

echo $min_cost . PHP_EOL;
?>

<?php
// Read input from STDIN
$input = trim(fgets(STDIN));
list($n, $m, $a, $b) = array_map('intval', explode(' ', $input));

// Option 1: buy all single ride tickets
$cost_single = $n * $a;

// Option 2: buy as many m-ride tickets as possible, then single tickets for the rest
$full_passes = intdiv($n, $m);
$remaining_rides = $n % $m;
$cost_mixed = $full_passes * $b + $remaining_rides * $a;

// Option 3: buy enough m-ride tickets to cover all rides (even if some rides are unused)
$cost_full_passes_only = (int)ceil($n / $m) * $b;

// Minimum of all options
$min_cost = min($cost_single, $cost_mixed, $cost_full_passes_only);

// Output result
echo $min_cost . PHP_EOL;
?>

<?php
// Read input
$input = trim(fgets(STDIN));
list($n, $m, $a, $b) = array_map('intval', explode(' ', $input));

// Option 1: all single tickets
$cost_single = $n * $a;

// Option 2: only m-ride tickets (possibly extra rides unused)
$cost_full_m = (int)ceil($n / $m) * $b;

// Option 3: combination of m-ride tickets and single tickets
$full_m_tickets = intdiv($n, $m);
$remaining_rides = $n % $m;
$cost_m_plus_single = $full_m_tickets * $b + $remaining_rides * $a;

// Minimum of all options
$min_cost = min($cost_single, $cost_full_m, $cost_m_plus_single);

echo $min_cost . PHP_EOL;
?>

<?php
// Read input
$input = trim(fgets(STDIN));
list($n, $m, $a, $b) = array_map('intval', explode(' ', $input));

// Option 1: all single tickets
$cost_single = $n * $a;

// Option 2: as many m-ride tickets as possible, remaining with single tickets
$full_m_tickets = intdiv($n, $m);
$remaining_rides = $n % $m;
$cost_mixed = $full_m_tickets * $b + $remaining_rides * $a;

// Option 3: only m-ride tickets (possibly more rides than needed)
$cost_only_m = (intdiv($n + $m - 1, $m)) * $b;

// Minimum of all options
$answer = min($cost_single, $cost_mixed, $cost_only_m);

echo $answer . PHP_EOL;
?>

oai_response.prompt:
Write a program in PHP to solve this programming problem:
Description: Ann has recently started commuting by subway. We know that a one ride subway ticket costs a rubles. Besides, Ann found out that she can buy a special ticket for m rides (she can buy it several times). It costs b rubles. Ann did the math; she will need to use subway n times. Help Ann, tell her what is the minimum sum of money she will have to spend to make n rides?
Input Specification: The single line contains four space-separated integers n, m, a, b (1 ≤ n, m, a, b ≤ 1000) — the number of rides Ann has planned, the number of rides covered by the m ride ticket, the price of a one ride ticket and the price of an m ride ticket. 
Output Specification: Print a single integer — the minimum sum in rubles that Ann will need to spend.

Sample Input:
6 2 1 2
Sample Output:
6

Sample Input:
5 2 2 3
Sample Output:
8

Notes: NoteIn the first sample one of the optimal solutions is: each time buy a one ride ticket. There are other optimal solutions. For example, buy three m ride tickets.
Take input from standard input and output to standard output
Provide the PHP code without any extra description or tokens. Target code:
